morphology.pattern_note: 这是可识别的苏格兰姓氏；实际文本通常首字母大写。开头 men- 不是马来语 meN- 前缀，词尾 -s 也不是马来语后缀。所列音标为传统苏格兰读法，并非已核定的马来语标准读音；无可确认的马来语派生词族。

senses.zh_definition: 苏格兰姓氏 Menzies；具体所指人物须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: A Scottish surname, conventionally written Menzies.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga Scotland yang lazimnya ditulis Menzies; orang yang dimaksudkan ditentukan oleh konteks.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词。输入未提供 DBP 释义，故不能标为已确认的官方马来语词条；此处马来语定义为编写说明。传统读法约为 Ming-is，也有按拼写发音的变体，应尊重姓名持有者的读法。以下为专名组合示例，并非高频搭配统计。[苏格兰语词典：Menzies](https://www.dsl.ac.uk/entry/snd/snd00089376)

dual_scenarios.context: 职场 / 虚构接待通知示例
dual_scenarios.ms: Pihak urus setia diminta mengesahkan ejaan nama Encik Menzies sebelum surat jemputan dikeluarkan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 请秘书处在发出邀请函前确认 Menzies 先生姓名的拼写。
dual_scenarios.en: The secretariat is requested to confirm the spelling of Mr Menzies’s name before issuing the invitation.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 同事核对来宾姓名的虚构对话
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Nama tetamu tu Menzies, kan? Dah semak ejaan?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Nama tetamu itu Menzies, betul? Adakah ejaannya sudah disemak?
dual_scenarios.zh: 那位来宾姓 Menzies，对吧？拼写核对过了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: The guest’s surname is Menzies, right? Have you checked the spelling?

etymology.historical_story: Menzies preserves a striking feature of Scottish writing history. Its z reflects the obsolete letter yogh, which printers sometimes replaced with a similar-looking character. That history helps explain the traditional pronunciation Ming-is. Later pronunciation also followed the modern spelling, so a person’s preferred pronunciation remains more useful than a rigid spelling-based guess. [Scotland’s People：字母 yogh](https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/scottish-handwriting/coaching/letter-finder/letter-yogh)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Menzies，先记“人名要问本人怎么念”；传统读法可记作 Ming-is。不要拆成马来语 men- 加词根。
